data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to view, theme, and copy Dart code snippets.
data.what_it_does: The dart_code_viewer2 package lets you easily display and copy formatted Dart code inside your Flutter application. It supports built-in themes, custom text styles, and color parameters for highlighting tokens like keywords, strings, comments, and types.
use_when: You need to display code examples inside a Flutter application
You want built-in support for copying code snippets to the clipboard
You need syntax highlighting and theme customization for code display
avoid_when: You need a full-featured code editor rather than just a viewer
You need support for highlighting languages other than Dart
strengths: Easy to set up with pre-made themes like light, dark, io17, and designDark
Supports custom text styling and color parameters per token type
Includes a copy button feature out of the box
weaknesses: Requires a Material ancestor and MediaQuery widget in the tree
data.setup_notes: No native setup required. Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.
